grants.scope: Within the lit area: Search for physical evidence, Identify Magic, Trace Possession, Identify Spiritual Affliction, or recognising evidence of a curse, haunt or transformation

warps.text: Spiritual traces up to 7 days old remain perceptible, provided they have not been magically erased

system.description:
GRIMWARD INSIGHT UTILITY
Grimward Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Area 15-foot burst
Duration 10 minutes

A pale radiance settles over the area, exaggerating disturbances left by physical and supernatural activity.
You gain a +2-status bonus to checks made within the affected area to:
Search for physical evidence;
Identify Magic;
Trace Possession;
Identify Spiritual Affliction; or
recognise evidence of a curse, haunt or supernatural transformation.
The spell does not identify who created the evidence, determine guilt or reveal information that left no trace.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the radius by 10 feet.
+2 PP: Spiritual traces up to 7 days old remain perceptible, provided they have not been magically erased.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
